title: Xcode 27 runner image generally available
author: Allison
description: You can now use the generally available Xcode 27 runner image to build and test your Apple applications in GitHub Actions. Previously in public preview, this GitHub-hosted image runs on… The post Xcode 27 runner image generally available appeared first on The GitHub Blog .
summary: You can now use the generally available Xcode 27 runner image to build and test your Apple applications in GitHub Actions. Previously in public preview, this GitHub-hosted image runs on macOS 27 and includes the Xcode 27 toolchain and Apple SDKs.
takeaways: Previously in public preview, this GitHub-hosted image runs on macOS 27 and includes the Xcode 27 toolchain and Apple SDKs.
This makes it easier to select the toolchain your project needs and know what each runner provides.
Get started To use the image, set your workflow’s runs-on: value to one of these labels: xcode-27 xcode-27-xlarge If you already use these labels, you don’t need to change your workflows.
